short: A heavily armed British battlecruiser that fought at Dogger Bank and Jutland before becoming the oldest capital ship in the postwar fleet.
full:
Commissioned on 3 October 1914, HMS Tiger was among the most heavily armoured battlecruisers of the Royal Navy. She featured an improved design that concentrated her 13.5-inch guns for better firing arcs, making her one of the most capable warships in the Grand Fleet. Due to her distinctive profile and three funnels, she was often considered the most beautiful warship of her era.

She saw significant combat during the First World War, participating in the Battle of Dogger Bank in 1915, where she suffered numerous hits but remained operational. At the Battle of Jutland in 1916, she survived fifteen direct hits from German heavy guns. Following the war, she was retained as a training ship and survived the Washington Naval Treaty scrapings, ultimately serving until she was decommissioned in 1931.
